x64.digestSource: sha256sum.txt published with the ollama/ollama v0.33.3 GitHub release (2026-09-02)

updatePolicy: Manually pin a specific OllamaSetup.exe release; bump version + re-hash sha256 each time. Linux pins the release ollama-linux-amd64.tar.zst with the digest copied from that release's sha256sum.txt.
packagingPath: Downloaded at runtime to the OS temp dir; never bundled in the installer. On Linux it is downloaded at runtime to the OS temp dir and extracted into $XDG_DATA_HOME/jenny/ollama (default ~/.local/share/jenny/ollama), never bundled.
rollback: Uninstall via Ollama's own uninstaller; Jenny never auto-uninstalls Ollama. Jenny never removes the Linux user-space install directory.
_comment: PROVENANCE MANIFEST (per docs/BUILDING.md § Release Provenance and Evidence). Pinned to Ollama v0.30.10 (2026-06-24). To update: download the new OllamaSetup.exe, run `(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\OllamaSetup.exe).Hash`, and update url/version/sizeBytes/sha256. If sha256 is ever left empty, getInstallPlan() reports available:false and installOllama() refuses to download (fail-closed). The Linux x64 entry pins ollama-linux-amd64.tar.zst separately under platforms.linux.x64 with the digest copied from that release's sha256sum.txt.
